title: QA admission
summary: Admission freezes each member's item cases and the plans its admitted item cases name; it never saves an attached post-deploy plan or writes an item copy of one. Those plans run at item QA as plan groups pinned at the run's first group of each plan. An older admission snapshot may still name attached plans without materialized run rows; migration admits it and item QA forms groups from live attachments, including authorized hosted environment targets. Old member copies and shared rows without group identity still block migration. New selections freeze complete plan and case definitions before executable rows. Incomplete historical selections refuse execution with reviewed operator repair recovery; no runtime legacy-plan reconstruction remains.
